stopping_rule.description: Stop when any: new hypotheses reach 25, 3 months elapse (2026-11-06), 80 research-hours logged, or 3 consecutive hypotheses fail at the same gate. Per stopping_rule_2026_08_06_direction_h.md §4.

sacred_holdout.open_policy: Opening this file and running any backtest against it counts as 1 trial. Cannot be reopened.
